definitions: A phenomenon where consumers become weary or annoyed by the increasing number of requests for tips, especially in situations where tipping was not traditionally expected or where the service quality does not warrant it.
The emotional and financial exhaustion experienced by customers due to the proliferation of tipping prompts and the pressure to tip in various service encounters.
examples: Many customers are experiencing tipping fatigue when faced with prompts at self-checkout kiosks.
The restaurant industry is grappling with tipping fatigue as patrons push back against automatic gratuities.
Rising prices combined with constant tipping requests are contributing to widespread tipping fatigue.
